The purpose of this market dialogue is to improve the Contracting Authority's understanding of available technologies, integration approaches, operational limitations, delivery models, costs and life-cycle implications before launching a possible procurement procedure. Suppliers and other market operators are therefore invited to provide information and comments on feasible operational performance, sensor integration, communication solutions, navigation and autonomy, maintenance concepts, information and cyber security, training, life-cycle services and other relevant aspects.
